description: A six-month NGO expense ledger with monthly subtotal rows, blank separators, and a grand total designed to tempt double counting.

questions.question: Excluding every monthly subtotal and the grand total row, what was total actual expenditure from April through September 2025, in INR?
questions.trap: Adding subtotal or grand-total rows double or triple counts the same expenses.

questions.question: Excluding subtotal and grand-total rows, how much was spent on Jal Jeevan Saathi in Maharashtra from April through September 2025, in INR?
questions.trap: The ledger's summary rows have blank programme and state fields and must not enter the filter.

questions.question: How many underlying expense transactions (rows with an EXP- transaction ID, not subtotal rows) were recorded for Poshan Shakti?
questions.trap: Counting visual month blocks or summary rows instead of transaction rows gives the wrong count.

questions.question: After excluding all subtotal and grand-total rows, which district had the highest total actual expenditure?
questions.trap: Summing the precomputed totals alongside detail rows corrupts district rankings.

questions.question: What percentage of total underlying expenditure was funded by Azim Premji Foundation? Exclude all subtotal and grand-total rows and report the percentage to two decimal places.
questions.trap: Using a denominator that includes monthly or grand totals understates the donor share.

questions.question: After excluding monthly subtotal and grand-total rows, which programme had the highest total actual expenditure?
questions.trap: The bold totals are not programme records and must not be grouped as if they were.
